answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with random walks stopped after a fixed number of steps, preventing distant endorsements from amplifying indefinitely. A sybil cluster may weave a thread of mutual attestations, but few links to the honest lagoon create a sparse external cut with low conductance. This bottleneck limits walk mass crossing into the cluster and, under bounded per-node influence, mathematically bounds its aggregate voting weight; a plume of fabricated identities adds little without external edges.
